item.title: Cathie Wood’s ARK Invest Buys Block, Nvidia & Securitize, Sells Shopify & Palantir
item.summary: Cathie Wood-led ARK Invest made Jack Dorsey's Block its largest purchase on August 17, adding it alongside more Nvidia and Securitize, while selling heavily out of Roblox, Shopify, Palantir, and AMD across several funds.
